# ZebAlpha (https://zebalpha.shop)

> ZebAlpha is an Indian e-commerce marketplace and streetwear apparel brand founded in Kolkata, West Bengal, by Rahul Adhikary (Founder & Chief Executive Officer) and Alakesh Biswas (Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer). ZebAlpha connects Indian shoppers directly with its own curated product offerings alongside independent sellers and emerging brands across 28,000+ Indian PIN codes at 0% seller commission.

## Leadership at ZebAlpha
- **Rahul Adhikary — Founder & Chief Executive Officer (CEO)**: Leads ZebAlpha's overall vision, business strategy, product innovation, technology direction, customer experience, brand positioning, and long-term growth.
- **Alakesh Biswas — Co-Founder & Chief Operating Officer (COO)**: Leads business operations and execution, seller onboarding and relationship management, operational planning, business process development, and team coordination.
- **Main Vision**: **Discover. Support. Grow.** — India's discovery-led e-commerce marketplace making online product discovery and brand-building accessible beyond metro cities across Bharat (Tier 2, Tier 3 & smaller cities).
- **Core Philosophy**: "Don't just work for the company. Build the company with us." — **ZebAlpha — Built Together. Growing Together.**

## Company vs Brand Identity
- **As a Company**: Focused on disciplined business growth, transparent marketplace economics, partnerships with sellers/team members/investors, and building a large, durable Indian commerce enterprise.
- **As a Brand**: Focused on deep customer trust, recognition & loyalty, reputation & retention, and becoming a trusted Indian household name.

## Target Customers (Bharat-First Mass Market)
- **Primary Demographics**:
  - **College Students (Age 18–24)**: Affordable fashion, heavyweight oversized streetwear, trendy everyday pieces & custom prints.
  - **Young Professionals (Age 22–35)**: Verified quality, convenience, reliable delivery, and honest value.
  - **Middle-Class Families (Age 25–45)**: Affordable household, ethnic, and lifestyle products with transparent pricing & clear returns.
- **Shopping Missions**: Value Seekers, Trend Discoverers, Local-First Shoppers (Tier 2 / Tier 3+), Gift & Custom Buyers, Family Households, and Emerging-Brand Fans.

## Target Sellers & Emerging Brands Programme
- **6 Priority Seller Segments**: Home-Based Businesses, Social Sellers (Instagram & WhatsApp), Makers & Artisans, Local Boutiques, Small Manufacturers, and Emerging Indian D2C Brands.
- **Emerging Brands Programme**: Dedicated brand storefronts, curated collections, founder/product storytelling, micro-creator collaborations with trackable links, seller analytics, and fair discovery rules for quality new brands.
- **Phased Cluster Rollout**: Phase 1 Kolkata → Phase 2 West Bengal → Phase 3 East India Tier-2/Tier-3+ → Phase 4 Pan-India (28,000+ PIN codes).

## What Makes ZebAlpha Different from Traditional & Value Marketplaces
- **Why Customers Choose ZebAlpha**:
  1. **Discovery-Led Curated Experience** — Discover credible emerging Indian labels and regional products instead of endless paid-ad clutter.
  2. **Real Product Video Proof** — Authentic video proof, exact GSM specs, independent color/size SKU stock, and verified buyer reviews.
  3. **Built-In Custom Print Studio (Zero MOQ)** — Order even a single custom-printed 240 GSM oversized tee, hoodie, or canvas tote bag with 1-click Background Removal.
  4. **Alpha AI Multilingual Voice & Chat Shopping** — Shop in Bengali (বাংলা), Banglish, Hindi (हिन्दी), Hinglish, or English with precision category + rating/order ranking.
  5. **Transparent Pricing & 5-Day Easy Returns** — Clear upfront prices, UPI/COD accepted, Flat ₹100 OFF on 1st order (₹399+, code FIRST100), and dependable 5-day returns.
- **Why Sellers & Emerging Brands Choose ZebAlpha** (beyond 0% commission alone):
  1. **Brand Storefront & Story** — Sellers build recognizable brands instead of fighting anonymous lowest-price commodity wars.
  2. **Creator-Led Micro-Influencer Distribution** — Measurable micro-creator product demos and try-ons tracked to verified delivered orders.
  3. **0% Core Commission + Zero Hidden Charges** — Transparent economics with 5-day direct UPI settlements.
  4. **Low-Friction Enrolment ID Onboarding** — Start with a free 15-character Enrolment ID, verified email, pickup address & UPI ID.
  5. **Fair Discovery + Actionable Insights** — Quality new sellers get fair visibility alongside views, add-to-cart, conversion, and return analytics plus hands-on growth guidance.

## Official Brand Facts
- Official Website: https://zebalpha.shop
- Seller Portal: https://seller.zebalpha.shop
- Android App (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zebalpha.customer
- Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/zebalpha_official/
- Headquarters: Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- Support Email: support@zebalpha.shop
- New Customer Welcome Offer: Flat ₹100 OFF on 1st order (orders ₹399+, auto-applied on COD and UPI/Card with code FIRST100)
- Payments: UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, Cash on Delivery (COD)
- Seller Model: 0% Commission marketplace for eligible Indian small businesses, boutiques, handmade creators, and independent brands with 5-day direct UPI payouts

## Primary Shopping & Feature Pages
- [Homepage](https://zebalpha.shop/): Featured collections, New Season Drops, Curated Categories, and trending streetwear.
- [All Products Catalog](https://zebalpha.shop/products): Full searchable catalog of ZebAlpha apparel and marketplace products.
- [ZebAlpha Custom Print Studio](https://zebalpha.shop/customize): Interactive garment customizer to print custom artwork on 240 GSM oversized tees, classic tees, heavyweight hoodies, and canvas tote bags.
- [New Season Drops](https://zebalpha.shop/new-drops): Limited-run streetwear drops and fresh culture arrivals.
- [Oversized T-Shirts (240+ GSM)](https://zebalpha.shop/category/oversized-t-shirts): Heavyweight drop-shoulder combed cotton oversized tees.
- [Polos & Zip Collars](https://zebalpha.shop/category/polos): 220–260 GSM textured knit and metallic zip polo t-shirts.
- [Hoodies & Sweatshirts](https://zebalpha.shop/category/hoodies): 350+ GSM heavyweight brushed fleece streetwear hoodies.
- [T-Shirts & Everyday Tops](https://zebalpha.shop/category/t-shirts): Pure combed cotton crewnecks and graphic streetwear tops.
- [Casual Shirts](https://zebalpha.shop/category/shirts): Relaxed cotton, oxford, and linen casual shirts.
- [Custom T-Shirts & Print-on-Demand](https://zebalpha.shop/category/custom-t-shirts): Design-your-own graphic tees and custom merch across India.
